data.summary: This week Ethan Qiu made 22 GitHub contribution-count commits across UTMIST/Misty, with 13 pushes there and additional pushes to qiuethan/Portfolio and qiuethan/now. He opened pull requests UTMIST/Misty#263, #265, #267, and #269, as well as qiuethan/Portfolio#3 through #6 and qiuethan/now#3. He also reviewed UTMIST/Misty#230, #258, #264, and #268, plus UTMIST/UTMIST#489.
